what_changed_today: RECOVERY EXTENDED: close 7,554.29 (+~4% off the 7,267 downleg low) has now fully reclaimed the 23.6% fib (7,553) and re-entered topping-zone territory, ~0.9% below the 7,621 swing high — the relief bounce has matured into a genuine recovery rally.

narrative_summary: The market has staged a sharp, orderly recovery from the early-June downleg — reclaiming the 20-day SMA, pushing the 23.6% fib at 7,553, and grinding back to within 1% of the 7,621 swing high with VIX cooling below 20 and no capitulation. But the rally is colliding with a hard valuation ceiling (ERP ~0.43%), breadth and credit that flatly refuse to confirm (McClellan Extreme Fear, junk spreads still wide), and a Monte Carlo edge that still favors downside-first. Inside a Late Bull / Topping regime this is a recovery into resistance, not a confirmed breakout. Posture is patience: respect the technical repair but do not chase strength into a zero-cushion ceiling.
